remarks: Tucked into one of New Canaan's most desirable in-town neighborhoods, 33 Village Drive offers the perfect blend of thoughtful renovation, comfortable living, and unbeatable convenience. Recently updated, the home features bright, open living spaces designed for today's lifestyle, with a seamless flow ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Generous room sizes, updated finishes, and great natural light create a warm and inviting feel throughout. Whether gathering in the main living areas or enjoying quieter moments at home, the layout offers flexibility and ease. The location is hard to beat. Just moments to schools, Waveny Park, the YMCA, and downtown New Canaan, everything you need is right at your fingertips. A turnkey opportunity in a truly special neighborhood.
